scope: committed-PC bounded region on the single configured RV64 hart

instrumentation_boundary.synthesis_scope: simulation-only; excluded from production core synthesis and STA

identity.memory_owner_key: OooMemOwnerTracker live token whose producer_id_table entry exactly equals the full ROB-head ProducerId
identity.memory_owner_onehot_requirement: zero or one live token may match one ROB-head ProducerId
memory_holder_sources: OooIntBackend memory reservation, buffer, retry, MIQ, SQ-owner, AMO-pending, request-fire, birth, terminal-pending, and terminal-accept masks
OooMemAxiBridge lane0/lane1 registered station token, active token, and state_q
identity.bridge_state_binding: OooMemAxiBridge localparam encoding frozen by this schema; an unrecognized active state is memory_lifecycle_unknown
identity.request_detail_binding: the nested request detail is non-NONE exactly when the primary reason is memory_request_outstanding and is selected from the one exact-token active bridge state

reason_encoding.name: retired
reason_encoding.meaning: one non-exception architectural instruction retired on this physical lane

reason_encoding.name: rob_empty
reason_encoding.meaning: the corresponding oldest ROB entry does not exist

reason_encoding.name: dependency
reason_encoding.meaning: the full-ProducerId head is resident in an integer or FP IQ and at least one enabled sticky source-ready bit is clear

reason_encoding.name: issue_terminal
reason_encoding.meaning: the full-ProducerId head is resident in an integer or FP IQ and all enabled sticky source-ready bits are set

reason_encoding.name: execution_latency
reason_encoding.meaning: the full-ProducerId head has left both IQ domains and is resident in a non-memory execution, completion, or system-owner mask

reason_encoding.name: memory_reservation_queue
reason_encoding.meaning: after higher-priority memory states, the head is in a registered reservation, buffer, MIQ, bridge station, SQ owner, AMO-pending, request-fire/birth holder, or pre-owner LQ/reservation residency

reason_encoding.name: memory_translation_order
reason_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is active in bridge S_WALK_AR, S_WALK_R, S_AD_UPDATE, or S_SQ_QUERY

reason_encoding.name: memory_request_outstanding
reason_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is active in bridge S_LOOKUP, S_DEVICE_WAIT, S_READ_ADDR, S_READ_DATA, S_WRITE_REQ, or S_WRITE_RESP; one nested request detail names the exact state group

reason_encoding.name: memory_response_terminal
reason_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is in bridge S_RESP, accepted/pending terminal collection, or its exact LQ entry has terminal_seen_q

reason_encoding.name: memory_retry
reason_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is resident in a registered retry0 or retry1 holder

reason_encoding.name: memory_lifecycle_unknown
reason_encoding.meaning: the head is memory-resident but no versioned exact-token lifecycle predicate explains it, including an unrecognized active bridge state

reason_encoding.name: head_lifecycle_unknown
reason_encoding.meaning: the corresponding ROB head is edge-old incomplete but no versioned full-ProducerId IQ, memory, or execution residency predicate explains it

reason_encoding.name: exception_redirect
reason_encoding.meaning: precise exception, flush, branch recovery, or checkpoint restore prevents architectural retirement

reason_encoding.name: memory_commit
reason_encoding.meaning: LQ release permission or CSR memory-quiet retirement permission is closed after completion

reason_encoding.name: serialization
reason_encoding.meaning: context, fence.i, control-plane commit, CSR single-retire, or lane1 serialization permission is closed after completion

reason_encoding.name: unknown
reason_encoding.meaning: no earlier versioned retirement-observation predicate explains the unused slot

request_detail_encoding.name: none
request_detail_encoding.meaning: the primary reason is not memory_request_outstanding; this code is never accumulated into the nested ledger

request_detail_encoding.name: cache_lookup
request_detail_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is active in OooMemAxiBridge S_LOOKUP

request_detail_encoding.name: device_wait
request_detail_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is active in OooMemAxiBridge S_DEVICE_WAIT

request_detail_encoding.name: axi_read_address
request_detail_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is active in OooMemAxiBridge S_READ_ADDR

request_detail_encoding.name: axi_read_data
request_detail_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is active in OooMemAxiBridge S_READ_DATA

request_detail_encoding.name: axi_write_request
request_detail_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is active in OooMemAxiBridge S_WRITE_REQ

request_detail_encoding.name: axi_write_response
request_detail_encoding.meaning: the exact head token is active in OooMemAxiBridge S_WRITE_RESP

request_detail_encoding.name: unknown
request_detail_encoding.meaning: the primary reason is memory_request_outstanding but no versioned one-bridge state mapping names the request phase

aggregate_binding.cycle_memory_request_outstanding: cycle_memory_request_cache_lookup + cycle_memory_request_device_wait + cycle_memory_request_axi_read_address + cycle_memory_request_axi_read_data + cycle_memory_request_axi_write_request + cycle_memory_request_axi_write_response + cycle_memory_request_detail_unknown
aggregate_binding.slot_memory_request_outstanding: slot_memory_request_cache_lookup + slot_memory_request_device_wait + slot_memory_request_axi_read_address + slot_memory_request_axi_read_data + slot_memory_request_axi_write_request + slot_memory_request_axi_write_response + slot_memory_request_detail_unknown
aggregate_binding.cycle_memory_latency: cycle_memory_reservation_queue + cycle_memory_translation_order + cycle_memory_request_outstanding + cycle_memory_response_terminal + cycle_memory_retry + cycle_memory_lifecycle_unknown
aggregate_binding.slot_memory_latency: slot_memory_reservation_queue + slot_memory_translation_order + slot_memory_request_outstanding + slot_memory_response_terminal + slot_memory_retry + slot_memory_lifecycle_unknown

cycle_partition.rule: a cycle is useful when at least one architectural instruction retires; otherwise it takes lane0's exclusive primary reason
cycle_partition.conservation: cycle_useful + cycle_rob_empty + cycle_dependency + cycle_issue_terminal + cycle_execution_latency + cycle_memory_latency + cycle_head_lifecycle_unknown + cycle_exception_redirect + cycle_memory_commit + cycle_serialization + cycle_unknown == cycles

retire_slot_partition.marker_interval: [before start committed lane, before end committed lane)
retire_slot_partition.conservation: retired_slots + slot_rob_empty + slot_dependency + slot_issue_terminal + slot_execution_latency + slot_memory_latency + slot_head_lifecycle_unknown + slot_exception_redirect + slot_memory_commit + slot_serialization + slot_unknown == slot_capacity

boundary_sampling.cycle_delta: inclusive cumulative counter at end minus inclusive cumulative counter at start, covering full cycles S+1..E
boundary_sampling.slot_endpoint_correction: add start-cycle lanes start_lane..1 and subtract end-cycle lanes end_lane..1 for both the primary and nested request-detail slot ledgers
boundary_sampling.same_cycle_lane0_to_lane1: one slot of capacity and one retired instruction when lane0 is the start marker and lane1 is the end marker

interpretation_boundary.classification_kind: edge-old holder-residency lifecycle and request phase, not exclusive causal latency
interpretation_boundary.overlap_resolution: the documented primary priority selects one reason; a request reason then selects one nested detail from the exact-token active bridge
interpretation_boundary.forbidden_inference: a bucket count alone does not prove that the named holder or bus phase caused every cycle attributed to it

known_gaps: memory_reservation_queue combines backend reservations, MIQ admission wait, bridge station wait, and architectural queue fallback
cache_lookup does not yet separate cache-array latency from arbitration or structural admission around S_LOOKUP
rob_empty is not yet split into frontend supply and downstream ROB-capacity feedback causes
issue_terminal combines selector, physical terminal, universal-owner, memory-pair, and downstream admission causes
region-bound ROB, IQ, LQ, SQ, MSHR, and memory-station occupancy histograms are not yet emitted
an instrumentation-on versus instrumentation-off cycle-equivalence cohort is not yet archived
this schema is a conserving ROB-head holder lifecycle stack with a request-phase subledger, not the final full-core causal CPI stack
